snippet.title: Steam, Smoke, Snow, and Simulation: Century of Steam Devlog
snippet.description:
Merry Christmas everyone! As an extra treat, we're releasing this early for you all to enjoy on this lovely holiday. In this video, Mark shows off some of the things he has been working on - namely, all things Steam, Smoke, and Steam Simulation, and how they tie into the global weather system!
